errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not labeled in the figure. The description hallucinates a label, likely inferred from the figure caption.
The peak of the line in 2011 is at approximately 5.00%, not 4.50%.
The value in 2013 is significantly higher than 2.00%; it is approximately 2.8%-3.0%.

The description completely omits the trend between 2013 and 2016, which includes the lowest point of the graph in 2015 (approximately -0.5%). It also fails to mention the plateau between 2017 and 2018.
The starting value in 2008 is closer to 10.5%, not 11.00%.
The value in 2019 is visibly above 2.00%, at approximately 2.3%.
